notes: Profile: mid-market SaaS that provides knowledge search and context-aware help widgets for B2B apps.
Primary ask: robust, cost-predictable embeddings pipeline + sub-100ms vector nearest-neighbor search for live product UX.
Evaluation path: start with Hosted API for quick POC (1 week), then move to Dedicated if throughput/costs justify.
POC scope: ingest ~100k historical docs (help center + product logs) -> create embeddings -> upsert to Pinecone/pgvector -> measure search latency and upsert throughput.
Targets from CTO: 'Nightly full re-index must finish within 3 hours' and '99th pctl query latency < 120ms in production'.
Throughput targets: embedding batch: 200k docs/night (~18 docs/sec sustained if 3-hour window) but prefer burst to 5k/sec for parallelization; search QPS target 150 qps with p95 <100ms.

Vector DB: currently using Pinecone; evaluating move to managed Milvus or pgvector on RDS for cost control. Need Redwood guidance on recommended routing and caching for 1-3 token prefixes and KV cache reuse across sessions.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget — senior PM emphasized desire to lower per-embed cost by 3-4x vs current OpenAI spend. Dedicated attractive if it reduces unit costs and gives predictable monthly commit.
Security: must pass SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS support for key lifecycle, and audit logs for data residency/regulatory customers.
Observability ask: token-level cost + per-route latency breakdowns, plus ability to trace embedding pipeline failures back to input doc IDs.
Quote from Head of Infra: 'We need deterministic nightly runs, not variable costs that spike with traffic.'
Internal stakeholders: CTO (decision-maker), Head of Infra (technical lead), Product (UX requirements), Security (compliance sign-off).
Decision factors: P50/P95 latency, embed throughput for batch jobs, unit cost per 1k embeds, ease of integrating with existing vector DB, and SLA for Dedicated capacity.
Notes on rollout: if POC meets latency and cost guardrails, they'll pilot Dedicated (one reserved pool, 2-quarter commit) for production traffic and keep Hosted as fallback for burst.
Data retention: require 1 year logs + 90-day debug traces; retention controls required for customers in EU (data_residency request).
Integration asks: Bulk upsert API, idempotent job IDs for retry/dedup, incremental embedding jobs (only changed docs), and backpressure handling during vector DB writes.
